REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOV Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Dili n Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE BIVAHENG PINOY NMENT Mr. RONALDO LEYVA Punong Barangay Barangay San Jose, Antipolo City Dear Punong Barangay Leyva: Legal Opinion No. 42 s. 2011 JUL 20 2011 CENTRAL RECORDS SECTION RELEASED NO. This pertains to your query on the proper application of Section 45 of the Local Government Code referring to the manner of filling up permanent vacancy in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Antipolo City in view of the vacancies which you and the late SP Member Mario Garcia caused. As informed, you and Mr. Garcia ran under the political party Lakas-Kampi CMD during the 2010 National and Local elections. Given your representations, please be informed that Section 45 of the Local Government Code, provides for the appointing official and the requirement to fill up a vacancy in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of component cities, thus:: "SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian . (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic successions provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (2) The governor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; (b) Only the nominee of that political party under which the sanggunian member concerned had been elected and whose elevation to the position next higher in rank created the Zast vacancy in the sanggunian shaZZ be appointed in the manner hereinabove provided. The appointee shalt come from the same politicat party as that of the sanggunian member who caused the vacancy and shatt serve the unexpired term of the vacant office. In the appointment herein mentioned, a nomination and a cer#ficate qf membership of the appointee from the highest official of the political party concerned are conditions sine qua non, and any appointment without such nomination and certification shall be nuzz and void ab initio and shaZZ be a ground for administrative action against the qfficiaZ responsible therefor.

-2- As regards your collateral query as to whether the Mayor was correct in his pronouncement on the appointment of Messrs. Marvin Garcia and Antonio Masancay to the vacant posts, we have to decline replying to it as this Department does not delve on press releases, given the probability of inaccuracy. Anent your query if the Mayor is the appointing authority for vacancies in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of component cities, we reply in the negative as Section 45 (a) (2) stated above is quite clear. Finally, there is no prescriptive period given by the law to fill up vacancies in any of the local legislative bodies. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, . JES B.
